author: The Infographics Show
description:
Jeff Bezos screwed up, and Blue Origin’s latest failure could cost NASA far more than a destroyed rocket. After billions of dollars in government investment, delays, technical setbacks, and a catastrophic New Glenn explosion have put America’s return to the Moon under serious pressure.

This video examines how Blue Origin became a critical part of NASA’s Artemis program, why its $3.4 billion lunar contract matters, and how problems with New Glenn, the BE-4 engine, Launch Complex 36, and supply-chain bottlenecks could delay future missions. We also explore Bezos’ legal battle with NASA, Blue Origin’s lobbying strategy, massive monthly costs caused by delays, and the company’s internal culture.
While SpaceX embraces a “fail fast” strategy, Blue Origin has built its reputation around slow, careful engineering. But when those failures finally happen, they can be far more damaging.
